commentary.text: 90+7' Joshua Smith is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' 3 - 1 GOAL! Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His strike went in off the left-hand post. The score is 3:1.
90+3' Southampton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
90+1' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) sends the resulting free kick a whisker wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
89' Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Joshua Smith has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
86' A nice pass gives Christian Norgaard (Brentford) the opportunity to shoot, but it's a weak shot and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
82' Russell Martin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Lallana (Southampton) replacing Joe Aribo.
82' Substitution. Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) in, Mikkel Damsgaard out.
81' Half-chance! Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) plays a pass into the box, but Mark Flekken reacts well to snuff out the attack.

80' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
75' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Kevin Schade is replaced by Sepp van den Berg (Brentford).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Vitaly Janelt as he is replaced by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).

75' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
73' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) is given a yellow card.
72' Southampton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Southampton. Southampton have been awarded a corner kick.
69' 3 - 0 Yoane Wissa (Brentford) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
68' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Joshua Smith saw the whole situation.
65' 2 - 0 It's 2:0! Mathias Jensen feeds Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.

64' A neat pass is well received by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
64' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
63' Southampton quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

62' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Southampton.
61' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Mateus Fernandes (Southampton).

61' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Southampton will take a corner.

60' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Southampton are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
57' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tyler Dibling (Southampton) replaces Taylor Harwood-Bellis.

53' Kevin Schade (Brentford) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Aaron Ramsdale makes a comfortable save.
52' Southampton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
51' The current number of corner kicks is 2:4.

46' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
46' Russell Martin makes a switch. Cameron Archer is coming on in place of Adam Armstrong (Southampton) at the start of the second period.
46' Substitution. William Smallbone makes his way off the pitch and Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) comes on as his replacement.
46' Referee Joshua Smith blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+4' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
45+3' Wonderful movement by Southampton. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Southampton comes to nothing.
43' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. The ball rebounds to Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.

41' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
39' Kristoffer Ajer is being substituted because of an injury. Thomas Frank sends Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) on the pitch.
38' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

38' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Jack Stephens (Southampton) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
38' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Southampton.
36' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner with a short pass.

36' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Christian Norgaard (Brentford). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
33' Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
29' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Joshua Smith's book.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
28' Joe Aribo (Southampton) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Aaron Ramsdale makes a comfortable save.
24' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
23' Joe Aribo (Southampton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
20' Joshua Smith shows the yellow card to Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) for a heavy challenge.
18' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
16' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
15' Jan Bednarek (Southampton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Joshua Smith blows for a foul.

14' Southampton slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
11' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
9' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
8' Southampton take a short corner kick.
7' The resulting set piece from Southampton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Southampton have a corner.

6' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Now Southampton have a corner.
5' Joe Aribo (Southampton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Brentford can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

2' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
1' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Southampton will have the kick-off.
Joshua Smith got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
